Tattoo - Fine-Line Accent.description:
🖋️ Tattoos: Fine-Line Accent
A delicate, thin-line tattoo — minimal ink work with clean precision, placed as a small accent on visible skin.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Tattoo - Fine-Line Accent.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: One small non-emissive fine-line abstract design on a compatible visible forearm or equivalent surface. Keep the design personal and unlettered.

Visual selection only: fit it to compatible visible surfaces; never invent limbs, horns, ears or other anatomy. Keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features. It adds no Quirk effect, item, protection, license or history.
